finite_goal: Prepare exact guarded probes of Windows share compatibility, held-object no-clobber rename and own-handle cleanup. These are prerequisites, not whole application or security acceptance.

scope_limit: No proof of process isolation, entire ancestor namespace, all filesystems, crash durability, journal recovery or prevention against all same-account actors. Own calls exercise native compatibility, not cross-process exploit coverage.
freeze: Independent ORACLE written before implementation, root reviews/refines before actual code. No native code/test execution by subagents.
